name: The Westin Bora Bora Resort & Spa

address.street: The Westin Bora Bora Resort & Spa

insider_take: This overwater paradise sits on a private motu with unobstructed views of Mount Otemanu, Bora Bora's ancient volcanic peak that rises dramatically 2,385 feet from the crystal-clear lagoon.
whats_special: The resort features Polynesia's largest overwater spa and some of the most spacious overwater villas in French Polynesia, each with direct lagoon access and glass floor panels for viewing tropical marine life below. The property is built on Motu Piti Aau, a private coral islet that was once a coconut plantation.
pro_tip: Book treatments at the Heavenly Spa during sunset hours – the overwater spa pavilions offer front-row seats to Bora Bora's legendary sunsets while you're pampered with traditional Polynesian healing rituals.
dont_miss: Snorkeling in Coral Gardens just minutes from the resort, where Napoleon wrasse, blacktip reef sharks, and rainbow parrotfish thrive in pristine waters. The lagoon here maintains a perfect 79-84°F year-round and offers visibility up to 150 feet.
pros: Overwater bungalows with direct lagoon access and stunning Mount Otemanu views
World-class Heavenly Spa with traditional Polynesian treatments
Multiple dining options including beachfront and overwater restaurants
Premium location on Bora Bora's main island with easy access to activities
cons: Remote island location requires flight connections and boat transfers
Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive Bora Bora destination
